article.headline: Semiconductor Rout Deepens as Nasdaq Plunges 3.8% Amid Fading Midterm Rally
article.summary: The S&P 500 fell 2.1% and the Nasdaq dropped 3.8% on Thursday as a sell-off in chip stocks countered the gains from the post-election surge.
article.body:
The PHLX Semiconductor index suffered a heavy blow on Thursday, sinking over 9% as major players Nvidia and Micron saw shares plummet 7% and 12% respectively. This sharp decline in the technology sector pushed the Nasdaq down by 3.8% and the S&P 500 by 2.1%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average retreated 1% from its recent highs. This pullback arrived immediately following a historic rally, which had previously secured the Dow its best single-day performance since April 2025.

Investors are now evaluating the economic consequences of the Democratic midterm victory and the resulting shift in congressional power. The uncertainty surrounding the political landscape has replaced the initial relief rally, creating a more cautious environment across Wall Street. Market participants are particularly focused on potential volatility tied to upcoming debt limit negotiations and the ongoing impacts of the war in Iran.

Oil prices have displayed conflicting trends according to financial reports. While some benchmarks saw a recent settlement lower by 8%, Yahoo Finance reports that Brent crude traded near $97 per barrel and WTI crude reached $90 per barrel on Thursday. Concerns remain that the administration may struggle to resolve the conflict in the Middle East, a factor that both market analysts and political figures have cited as influential in the recent electoral outcome.

Looking ahead, markets are bracing for additional volatility as they await the release of Friday’s key employment report. Companies are currently shifting their focus toward employee retention, with layoff plans in October reaching their lowest level since 2023, according to Challenger, Gray & Christmas data.

article.headline: Catastrophic Flash Flood Warning Forces McCaysville Shutdown as Waters Rise Across Georgia
article.summary: The National Weather Service issued a catastrophic flash flood warning for north Georgia, triggering a state of emergency and bridge closures in McCaysville.
article.body:
A catastrophic flash flood warning remains active for Fannin, Gilmer, Murray, and Union counties following heavy rainfall that submerged roads and businesses. McCaysville officials officially declared a state of emergency at 5:20 a.m. on Thursday as rising floodwaters forced the closure of multiple access points, including areas near Blue Ridge Drive and the Steel Bridge. Police Chief and Public Safety Director Michael O. Earley warned that downtown shops have already been impacted by the deluge, prompting evacuations and restricting city access to emergency personnel only.

Residents in the region are under strict orders to avoid driving or walking through any flooded areas. The closure of key transit bridges and roads presents a significant danger to the public, and authorities are prioritizing the safety of citizens and emergency responders as they work to evacuate families displaced from their homes. The situation remains fluid, with local officials emphasizing that these mandates are necessary to prevent further casualties during the ongoing severe weather event.

While parts of the region grapple with these emergency conditions, other areas expect a front to move through Thursday morning, bringing scattered showers. According to WDBJ7, this front will likely bring a final batch of rain to eastern areas before moving out on Friday. Residents are cautioned that environmental conditions can change rapidly and are advised to follow all local emergency directives until warnings are lifted.

article.headline: World Number 19 Alexandra Eala Storms Into Prudential Hong Kong Open Draw
article.summary: Filipino tennis star Alexandra Eala faces American Alycia Parks in the first round of the WTA 250 tournament at Victoria Park Tennis Stadium this Tuesday.
article.body: Alexandra Eala enters the Prudential Hong Kong Open ranked world number 19, carrying the second seed into a tournament that marks the final tour-level event of the 2026 season for non-WTA Finals qualifiers. Her return to Hong Kong follows an active stretch of competition that included a quarterfinal appearance last week at the WTA 500 Toray Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo, where she narrowly fell to tournament winner Diana Shnaider in three sets. Eala expressed her excitement at a pre-event press conference on Monday, noting that the crowd and hospitality she experienced during her previous appearance made the return to the event a priority. The Hong Kong tournament serves as a key opportunity for Eala to regain momentum following early exits in Wuhan and Singapore during the recent Asian swing. While Eala successfully secured a singles bronze medal at the Nagoya Asian Games on October 1, her subsequent results in China and Singapore included a difficult loss to world number 180 Tatiana Prozorova at the Singapore Open. According to the Philippine News Agency, Eala is looking to build on the foundation of her 2025 performance at this venue, where she previously advanced past the Round of 32. After her opening match against Parks, Eala is set to navigate a path that could include a second-round meeting with Czech player Tereza Valentova. The outcome of this event will close out the competitive schedule for Eala before the season concludes, as the professional tour shifts focus toward the upcoming WTA Finals held in Indian Wells from November 8 to 15.

news.title: عام / مشروع "مسام" ينزع أكثر من 2,000 لغم من مختلف الأراضي اليمنية في أسبوع
news.og_title: عام / مشروع "مسام" ينزع أكثر من 2,000 لغم من مختلف الأراضي اليمنية في أسبوع
news.og_desc:
عدن 22 جمادى الأولى 1448 هـ الموافق 02 نوفمبر 2026 م واس
    تمكَّن مشروع مركز الملك سلمان للإغاثة والأعمال الإنسانية "مسام" لتطهير الأراضي اليمنية من الألغام، خلال الأسبوع الأخير من شهر أكتوبر للعام 2026م، من انتزاع (2,037) لغمًا في مختلف مناطق اليمن، منها (109) ألغام مضادة للدبابات، و(33) لغمًا مضادًا للأفراد، و(1,890) ذخيرة غير منفجرة، و(5) عبوات ناسفة.
    ونزع فريق "مسام" في مديرية زنجبار بمحافظة أبين لغمًا واحدًا مضادًا للدبابات و(5) ذخائر غير منفجرة، وفي محافظة عدن نزع (11) لغمًا مضادًا للأفراد و(65) لغمًا مضادًا للدبابات و(287) ذخيرة غير منفجرة.
    كما نزع الفريق بمديرية قعطبة بمحافظة الضالع ذخيرة واحدة غير منفجرة، وفي مديرية المكلا بمحافظة حضرموت نزع (11) لغمًا مضادًا للأفراد و(4) ألغام مضادة للدبابات و(1,076) ذخيرة غير منفجرة وعبوة ناسفة واحدة، إضافة إلى نزع (7) ألغام مضادة للأفراد و(25) لغمًا مضادًا للدبابات و(51) ذخيرة غير منفجرة في مديرية ميدي بمحافظة حجة، وفي محافظة لحج نزع ذخيرتين غير منفجرتين وعبوة ناسفة واحدة بمديرية العند، وذخيرة واحدة غير منفجرة بمديرية الوهط، وذخيرة واحدة غير منفجرة بمديرية تبن.
    وفي محافظة مأرب نزع الفريق (3) ألغام مضادة للأفراد ولغمين مضادين للدبابات و(5) ذخائر غير منفجرة بمديرية رغوان، و(12) لغمًا مضادًا للدبابات و(421) ذخيرة غير منفجرة و(3) عبوات ناسفة بمديرية مأرب، وفي محافظة شبوة نزع الفريق لغمًا واحدًا مضادًا للأفراد و(40) ذخيرة غير منفجرة بمديرية عسيلان.
    وبذلك يرتفع عدد الألغام المنزوعة منذ بدء شهر أكتوبر حتى الآن إلى (6,511) لغمًا، فيما ارتفع إجمالي الألغام المنزوعة منذ بداية مشروع "مسام" حتى الآن إلى (600,000) لغم، زرعتها الميليشيا الحوثية الإرهابية عشوائيًا في مختلف الأراضي اليمنية لحصد أرواح الأبرياء من الأطفال والنساء وكبار السن، وزرع الخوف في قلوب الآمنين.
    وتواصل المملكة العربية السعودية، عبر ذراعها الإنساني مركز الملك سلمان للإغاثة، جهودها في تطهير الأراضي اليمنية من الألغام، ضمن مشروع يُعزِّز سلامة المدنيين، ويسهم في تمكين الأشقاء اليمنيين من عيش حياة كريمة وآمنة.
    // انتهى //
